steps.name: Step 1: Defeat the Fire Demon with him in Undead Settlement.
Step 2: Throw his armor down the well at Cathedral of the Deep.
Step 3: Speak to him in the Irithyll of the Boreal Valley kitchen.
Step 4: Free him from his cell in Irithyll Dungeon.
Step 5: Defeat Yhorm the Giant with him.

category_quests.name: Anri of Astora (Lord of Hollows Route)

steps.name: Step 1: Speak to Anri and Horace at the Halfway Fortress.
Step 2: Speak to Anri at Firelink Shrine after defeating Deacons of the Deep.
Step 3: Speak to Anri in the Catacombs of Carthus (twice). Do NOT tell Anri about Horace.
Step 4: Speak to Anri at the Church of Yorshka bonfire. Do NOT kill the pilgrim assassin.
Step 5: Perform the 'wedding' ceremony in the Darkmoon Tomb.
Step 1: Speak to her at Firelink Shrine. Do NOT offer a Pale Tongue to Rosaria.
Step 2: Give Dreamchaser's Ashes to the Shrine Handmaid, then speak to Sirris at Firelink.
Step 3: Assist her in killing Creighton on the Irithyll bridge.
Step 4: Speak to her at Firelink to receive the Silvercat Ring.
Step 5: Assist her in killing Hodrick at the Pit of Hollows.
